{"id":1629908017,"question_id":72,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 2 months","timestamp":1746865683,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1629908017/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Edit Distance","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int solve(string &word1, string &word2 , int i , int j)\n    {\n        //base case \n        if(i >= word1.size()) return word2.size() - j;\n        if(j >= word2.size()) return word1.size() - i;\n\n        int ans = 0;\n        if(word1[i] == word2[j])\n        {\n            ans  = 0 + solve(word1 , word2 , i+1 , j+1);\n        }\n        else\n        {\n            int insert = 1 +  solve(word1 , word2 , i , j+1);\n\n            int remove = 1 +  solve(word1 , word2 , i+1 , j);\n            \n            int replace = 1 +  solve(word1 , word2 , i+1 , j+1);\n\n            ans = min(insert , min(remove , replace));\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n    int minDistance(string word1, string word2) {\n        \n        return solve(word1 , word2 , 0 , 0);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"edit-distance","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":582}
